intro-zh: 对准外壳，按住握持键并移动手柄来旋转，松手停止。对准前窗，按下并松开握持键可打开前窗。
intro-en: Aim at the shell. Hold Grip and move the controller to turn the helmet. Release to stop. Aim at the front window, then press and release Grip to open it.
air-zh: 这个演示中，水面团队用泵通过软管为头盔供气。
air-en: In this demo, the team at the surface pumps air through a hose to the helmet.
voice-zh: 这个演示中，潜水员通过电缆和水面团队双向通话。
voice-en: In this demo, a cable lets the diver and the team at the surface talk to each other.
